info.title: CAWASMA — Context-Aware Web & API Security Misconfiguration Analyzer
info.description: Defensive black-box security misconfiguration analyzer. Public routes follow API contract v1.2.0 (tag 'contract v1'; docs/api-contract.md). Deprecated routes serve the pre-contract frontend and will be removed.

get.description: Return service status and dependency liveness.
Return service status and dependency liveness.

post.description:
Validate the target and queue a scan. Poll ``GET /api/results/{scan_id}``.

``authorisation_confirmed`` must be ``true`` (the schema rejects anything
else with 422). The scan runs in this process as a background task for now
(QUEUED -> RUNNING -> DONE | FAILED); the Celery worker takes over later.

get.description:
Always 200 for a known scan. ``findings`` and ``chains`` stay empty until
``scan.status`` is ``DONE``. Filters combine with AND (values of one filter
with OR); ``severity_counts`` and ``chains`` always cover the whole scan, and
``findings_meta.total`` counts the filtered findings.

FindingResponse.title: FindingResponse
FindingResponse.description:
Public finding shape.

JSON names predate the DB column renames and are kept so the frontend keeps
working (docs/db-decisions.md, D2): ``rule_id`` <- ``check_id``,
``cvss_base_score`` <- ``base_score``, ``cawasma_final_score`` <-
``final_score``, ``severity`` <- ``severity_bucket``, ``evidence`` <-
``evidence["text"]`` (full JSON in ``evidence_details``).
